question.text: If one of the lines of $m y^2+\left(1-m^2\right) x y-m x^2=0$ is a bisector of the angle between the lines $x y=0$, then $m$ is

solution.text:
Equation of bisectors of lines $x y=0$ are $y=\pm x$ 
put $y=\pm x$ in $m y^2+\left(1-m^2\right) x y-m x^2=0$, we get $\left(1-m^2\right) x^2=0$ 
$\Rightarrow m=\pm 1$.
